queries.name: pSurveyYearIfMissing
queries.description: Only used when FactShipments.csv has NO SURVEY_YEAR column: set 2012 or 2017 for a single-year file; leave blank otherwise.

queries.name: FactShipments
text: else if List.Contains({"2012", "2017"}, Promoted) then Table.AddColumn(Promoted, "SURVEY_YEAR", each Promoted, type text)

else error Error.Record("FactShipments.csv has no SURVEY_YEAR column", "The dashboard compares 2012 with 2017, so every row needs SURVEY_YEAR. Add a SURVEY_YEAR column (2012 or 2017) to FactShipments.csv in Alteryx and refresh. If this file holds ONE survey year only, open Transform data > Manage parameters, set pSurveyYearIfMissing to 2012 or 2017, and refresh.", [ColumnsFound = Text.Combine(Table.ColumnNames(Promoted), ", ")]),
Needed = List.Distinct({"EXPORT_YN", "HAZMAT", "TEMP_CNTL_YN"} & List.Combine(List.Transform(List.Select(Cols, each not List.Contains(Cols, _{0})), each _{1}))),

else error Error.Record("FactShipments.csv is missing columns the dashboard needs", "Missing: " & Text.Combine(MissingBase, ", ") & ". Use the standard CFS PUF column names and refresh.", [ColumnsFound = Text.Combine(Cols, ", ")]),
// derived columns: kept as is when the file already has them, computed from the base columns when it does not
AddIfMissing = (t as table, name as text, fn as function, typ as type) as table =>
if Table.HasColumns(t, name) then t else Table.AddColumn(t, name, fn, typ),
Txt = (v) => if v = null then "" else Text.Trim(Text.From(v)),
Pad2 = (v) => let s = Txt(v) in if Text.Length(s) = 1 then "0" & s else s,
HazmatMap = [N = "Not hazardous", P = "Class 3 flammable liquid", H = "Other hazardous"],
ExportDest2017 = [C = "Canada", M = "Mexico", E = "Europe & Africa", A = "Asia & Oceania", S = "Rest of the Americas", O = "Other foreign countries"],
D01 = AddIfMissing(Typed, "SURVEY_YEAR_LABEL", each Text.From([SURVEY_YEAR]), type text),
D02 = AddIfMissing(D01, "ORIGIN_KEY", each Text.From([SURVEY_YEAR]) & "-" & Txt([ORIG_CFS_AREA]), type text),
D03 = AddIfMissing(D02, "DESTINATION_KEY", each Text.From([SURVEY_YEAR]) & "-" & Txt([DEST_CFS_AREA]), type text),
D04 = AddIfMissing(D03, "INDUSTRY_KEY", each Text.From([SURVEY_YEAR]) & "-" & Txt([NAICS]), type text),
D05 = AddIfMissing(D04, "COMMODITY_KEY", each Text.From([SURVEY_YEAR]) & "-" & Pad2([SCTG]), type text),
D06 = AddIfMissing(D05, "MODE_KEY", each Text.From([SURVEY_YEAR]) & "-" & Pad2([MODE]), type text),
D07 = AddIfMissing(D06, "FLOW_TYPE", each if Pad2([ORIG_STATE]) = Pad2([DEST_STATE]) then "Intrastate" else "Interstate", type text),

D08 = AddIfMissing(D07, "EXPORT_GROUP_HARMONIZED", each let c = Code([EXPORT_CNTRY]) in if c = "" or c = "N" then "Not export" else Record.FieldOrDefault(ExportGroupMap, c, "Other international"), type text),
D09 = AddIfMissing(D08, "HAZMAT_GROUP", each Record.FieldOrDefault(HazmatMap, Code([HAZMAT]), "Unknown"), type text),
D10 = AddIfMissing(D09, "TEMP_CONTROL_GROUP", each Record.FieldOrDefault(TempMap, Code([TEMP_CNTL_YN]), "Unknown"), type text),

D11 = AddIfMissing(D10, "EXPORT_DESTINATION", each let c = Code([EXPORT_CNTRY]) in if c = "" or c = "N" then "Not an export" else if [SURVEY_YEAR] = 2012 then Record.FieldOrDefault(ExportDest2012, c, "Code " & c & " (2012)") else Record.FieldOrDefault(ExportDest2017, c, "Code " & c & " (2017)"), type text),
// lean model: only the columns the report and measures use (names come from the Dim tables via the keys)
